methods_quotes.q: These initiations were also compared with CDC PrEP initiation targets to assess percentages achieved.
The annual number of PrEP initiations was defined as persons enrolled in tenofovir-based oral PrEP during each fiscal year.
All analyses were performed using Stata software (version 16; StataCorp).
Although programs started reporting PrEP initiations by key population in 2017, initiations by key populations were not reported uniformly until 2019.
